recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a central framed photograph of a man in 1970s attire standing on a road, surrounded by a thick yellow border with a vertical red and white sidebar on the left and prominent serif text at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Central square image framed by a heavy black border within a larger yellow field
Vertical sidebar on the left edge creating a secondary information zone
Large-scale serif typography centered in the upper yellow margin
Color blocking between primary yellow, deep red, and the natural tones of the photo
coreInvariants: Black inner frame around the central photograph
Vertical red block at the bottom left containing white text
High-waisted, wide-leg fashion in the central subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body portrait centered within the inner frame, occupying approximately 60% of the total height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's stance on the yellow road line acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top display text, moves down to the central figure, then follows the vertical sidebar on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant yellow margins provide breathing room for the central image and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Bright yellow background for high visibility and retro feel.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy blue text and black framing for legibility and structure.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Solid red block in the lower left sidebar for branding emphasis.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation primaries (yellow, red) contrasted against naturalistic, slightly desaturated 70s film photography.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Classic serif for the main title paired with a functional, clean sans-serif for technical metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the traditional high-contrast serif look of the 70s.
Matches the clean, technical look of the sidebar metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a wide yellow border. Inside the border, place a smaller square photograph with a thick black frame. The photo should show a man in a 1970s plaid shirt and bell-bottom jeans standing on an asphalt road with a yellow line, under a blue sky. Leave a vertical white strip on the far left edge, with a red block at the bottom of that strip.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a navy blue serif font, centered in the top yellow margin. Add vertical, uppercase sans-serif text in grey along the top left white strip. Add lowercase white serif text inside the red block on the bottom left.

verificationChecks: Is the yellow border consistent and vibrant?
Is the main text a high-contrast serif?
Is the photo framed with a distinct black border?
Is the sidebar text rotated 270 degrees?

adjustableVariables: Landscape vs. road setting in the photo
mustRedesign: Specific logos or brand marks in the sidebar
Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Balanced framing of the central image
avoid: Overly sharp, high-definition digital photo effects

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is navy blue, not black.
Check that the road line in the photo aligns with the subject's feet.
Verify the vertical sidebar is on the far left edge.
Confirm the black frame around the photo is uniform.
recipe.reuseFormula: Yellow field + Black-framed 70s photo + Top-centered Serif + Left-aligned vertical metadata strip.
